description: The operations HkdfGuard.Integration.HashiCorpVault generates from openapi.json: logging in and managing tokens, the KV and cubbyhole secrets engines, the transit engine (HkdfGuard's KMS), and a few system endpoints. Each entry is a regular expression matched against a method name without its Async suffix, and must match at least one. Anything else stays reachable through VaultClient's generic Read, Write, List and Delete. Regenerate after changing this: dotnet run --project tools/HkdfGuard.Integration.HashiCorpVault.Generator
